notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: the Sidekick assistant now remembers your language — pick Serbian (sr-RS), English (US/UK) or Swedish (sv-SE) and it stays selected instead of resetting to Auto; the assistant then consistently answers in that language. In Auto mode it detects the language of your question (Serbian/Swedish/English) and replies in the same language. Voice input and response language share the same persisted setting. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
